The Motorola Moto G86 is powered by 2.5 GHz Octa-core processor and it comes with 8GB of RAM. The Motorola Moto G86 packs 256GB of internal storage that can be expanded via microSDXC (dedicated slot).The Motorola Moto G86 runs Android 15 and is powered by a 5200mAh non-removable battery.
 FREQUENCIES : COMPATIBLE TO USE WITH NETWORK SIM CARDS THAT WORKS ONSIM CARD:2G : GSM 850 / 900 / 1800 / 1900 and/or3G : HSDPA 850(B5) / 900(B8) / 1900(B2) / 2100(B1) and/or4G : FDD-LTE 600(B71) / 700(B28) / 800(B20) / 850(B5) / 850(B26) / 900(B8) / 1500(B32) / 1800(B3) / 1900(B2) / 2100(B1) / 2600(B7) : TDD-LTE 2300(B40) / 2500(B41) / 2600(B38) / 3500(B42) and/or5G : NR N1/N3/N5/N7/N8/N20/N26/N28/N38/N40/N41/ N71/ N77/N78+ESIM
 IMPORTANT : PLEASE CHECK WITH YOUR NETWORK PROVIDER FOR COMPATIBILITY CHECK BEFORE YOU PURCHASE.
